name: ELYSIUM PLANITIA — InSight landing site

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 199 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Chosen by NASA precisely for being boring: the flattest, safest plain they could find. Here that makes it the control.

blurb: Chosen by NASA precisely for being dull: the flattest, safest, least interesting plain they could find, because the mission listened to the inside of the planet rather than looking at the outside. Here that makes it the control.

metrics.signature: plant → push hard → sink → rearward slip → delayed high extraction
flat plant → gradual load → controlled sink → vertical extraction → short forward swing
